name: wisps
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Production pixel-art sprite sheet for Frostline, a snowy downhill ski game. Attached gritty-sprites atlas is STYLE/SCALE guidance only, never an edit target. Match its tiny crisp low-resolution PC-game pixel clusters, dark slate outlines, off-white snow, muted blue-violet shadows and restrained warm accents. Core colours: ink #344b53, snow #edf1df, shade #a6bec5, teal #508d92, gold #e4bd6f. Same above/front 3/4 downhill game view. Cute, characterful and beautifully readable with a strong organic silhouette, never crude boxes or a smooth HD painting. The player is only 22 logical pixels wide; design to survive the stated native width. Each cell holds one complete isolated pose, same identity and character scale, consistent ground/foot baseline; generous transparent gutters, no clipping or cell overlap. Genuine transparent alpha background. No background scene, text, labels, grid lines, watermark, cast shadow, gradients, blur, smooth vector edges or painted checkerboard. The engine adds ground shadows and dynamic glow, so do not paint either around sprites. No extra characters. Follow the exact pose order. For cycles the poses must be consecutive articulated phases, never left/right mirrored substitutes.
Subject and exact sequence: A GROUP OF EXACTLY THREE tiny floating WILL-O-THE-WISPS, pale green to creamy-white pixel flames with two tiny dark eyes each. Entire three-flame group must read at only22 logical pixels wide. Four poses in2x2: float with left flame high; float with right flame high; drift/lean together; a crisp changing flame-tip flicker. Same three identities and overall size. Use a dark teal rim and pale cores so silhouettes read on white snow and dark night. No diffuse glow halo, gradients, background or ground; magical lighting is rendered in code. No shield/pickup icon in the flame group.
Layout: exactly 2 columns by 2 rows, 4 cells, read left to right across rows. Target maximum native width 22px and height 26px. Ground/feet or floating-body anchor stays registered in each cell.
